definitions.gloss: Showa Station (Japanese research base in Antarctica)
definitions.explanation: Japan's main research station in Antarctica, opened in 1957 on East Ongul Island. Each year a team of the Japanese Antarctic Research Expedition travels there on the icebreaker Shirase and spends a year observing weather, ice and the aurora.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
The station is named after the Showa era in which it was built. Many Japanese know it through the story of the sled dogs Taro and Jiro, who survived a winter alone there in 1958–59 after the expedition had to leave them behind; the story was made into the film {南極物語|なんきょくものがたり}.
